_readme: Fill in `credentials` with the ids each portal issues you. Anything left
blank still builds - the placeholder is written through verbatim and the
build prints a warning - so you can generate every zip before you have
every account, then rebuild the one target once its id arrives.
`head` is injected into index.html between the PLATFORM-SDK markers.
`options` becomes window.__PLATFORM_OPTIONS__, read by the adapter.

platforms.label: CrazyGames
platforms.revshare: Up to 70% net ad revenue (rises with exclusivity)
head: <!-- CrazyGames HTML5 v3 SDK. Must load before the game boots. -->
<script src="https://sdk.crazygames.com/crazygames-sdk-v3.js"></script>
notes: Only portal here with a native invite/room API - the online lobby uses it.
Every asset except this SDK must ship inside the zip; no other CDN calls.
adsEnabled stays false for Basic Launch, where CrazyGames serves no ads and QA rejects a rewarded button that does nothing. Set it to true for the Full Launch build.
midgameCooldownMs is 0 because the CrazyGames SDK enforces ad frequency itself (max one midgame per 3 minutes) and drops early requests silently.

platforms.label: Poki
platforms.revshare: ~50% on Poki-sourced players, 100% on players you bring
platforms.submission: Poki for Developers upload (zip or Git)
head: <script src="https://game-cdn.poki.com/scripts/v2/poki-sdk.js"></script>
notes: Poki decides ad timing - the adapter disables our own interstitial cooldown.
Mobile/touch support is effectively mandatory for approval.
No external links, no other ad SDKs, no third-party analytics.

platforms.label: GameDistribution
platforms.revshare: ~33% of net ad + IAP revenue, EUR 100 payout floor
platforms.submission: zip upload; game id issued on creation
head: <script>
// Defined before the SDK loads. The adapter attaches __forward once it
// boots; anything the SDK fires before then is buffered, not lost.
window.GD_OPTIONS = {
gameId: "{{GD_GAME_ID}}",
onEvent: function (event) {
var o = window.GD_OPTIONS;
if (o.__forward) o.__forward(event);
else (o.__buffered = o.__buffered || []).push(event);
</script>
<script src="https://html5.api.gamedistribution.com/main.min.js"></script>
notes: Turn on the REWARDED ADS flag in the dashboard or rewarded requests are refused.
Syndicates onward to thousands of small portals - widest reach per upload.

platforms.label: GameMonetize
platforms.revshare: Ad revenue share, published rate varies by deal
platforms.submission: hosted URL or zip; game id issued on creation
head: <script>
window.SDK_OPTIONS = {
gameId: "{{GAMEMONETIZE_GAME_ID}}",
advertisementSettings: { autoplay: false },
onEvent: function (event) {
var o = window.SDK_OPTIONS;
if (o.__forward) o.__forward(event);
else (o.__buffered = o.__buffered || []).push(event);
</script>
<script src="https://api.gamemonetize.com/sdk.js"></script>
notes: Same engine as GameDistribution, separate account and payout.

platforms.label: Yandex Games
platforms.revshare: Ad revenue share via Yandex Advertising Network
platforms.submission: zip upload through the developer console
head: <script src="https://sdk.games.s3.yandex.net/sdk.js"></script>
notes: Real cloud saves: progress follows a logged-in player across devices.
LoadingAPI.ready() must fire or the portal loader stays over the game.
A Russian-language build scores much better in their catalogue.

platforms.label: GamePix
platforms.submission: zip upload from the partner dashboard
head: <!-- Replace with the per-game snippet from your GamePix dashboard;
the default below is their public dev/stub library. -->
<script src="{{GAMEPIX_SDK_URL}}"></script>
notes: The adapter feature-detects both the legacy and current GamePix APIs.
The stub library shows placeholder breaks only - it never serves real ads.

platforms.label: Y8
platforms.revshare: 50% of in-game ad revenue, or direct AdSense (AFP)
head: <script>
// y8sdk.ready fires exactly once and can beat our modules, so latch it.
window.__y8Ready = new Promise(function (resolve) {
window.addEventListener('y8sdk.ready', function () { resolve(window.y8); }, { once: true });
</script>
<script src="https://cdn.y8.com/minimal-sdk/2-0/y8.min.js" async></script>
notes: Ads are Google AFP; register the app at https://account.y8.com/applications/.
AFP mode pays you through your own AdSense account instead of Y8 invoicing.

platforms.label: Lagged
head: <script src="https://lagged.com/api/rev-share/lagged.js"></script>
notes: Rewarded is a two-step handshake: availability first, then playback.
Interstitials give no callback on a no-fill, so the adapter times them out.

platforms.label: Playgama Bridge (multi-platform)
head: <script src="https://bridge.playgama.com/v2/stable/playgama-bridge.js"></script>
notes: One integration fronts VK, OK, Telegram/Playdeck, YouTube Playables, MSN and more.
Reward only on state 'rewarded' - 'closed' also fires for skips.
Do not ship this build to a portal that has its own adapter here; use that one.

platforms.label: Newgrounds
platforms.revshare: Site-wrapper ad share + Supporter pool, $50 payout floor
head: <!-- Newgrounds serves its own ads around the game frame: there is no ad
SDK to embed. Medals and scoreboards go over plain HTTP instead. -->
notes: Leave the ids blank to ship a clean, fully offline build.

platforms.label: Self-hosted / Netlify (Monetag)
platforms.revshare: You keep 100% of whatever the ad network pays you
platforms.submission: drag dist/selfhost into Netlify, or `netlify deploy --prod`
head: <!-- Monetag SDK. Only this promise-based SDK is wired into the game. If you
also paste a page-level Monetag tag (vignette / in-page push), put it
here as well — it runs on its own and needs nothing from the game. -->
<script src="https://{{MONETAG_SDK_DOMAIN}}/sdk.js" data-zone="{{MONETAG_ZONE_ID}}" data-sdk="show_{{MONETAG_ZONE_ID}}"></script>

extraFiles.netlify.toml:
# Netlify config for the self-hosted build.
#
# The game ships unbundled ES modules with no content hashing, so index.html,
# src/ and styles/ MUST revalidate on every load. Cache those hard and a deploy
# goes out while players keep running yesterday's JavaScript.

[build]
  publish = "."

[[headers]]
  for = "/*.html"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate"

[[headers]]
  for = "/src/*"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate"

[[headers]]
  for = "/styles/*"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate"

# Vendored and version-pinned: safe to cache for a year.
[[headers]]
  for = "/vendor/*"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"

[[headers]]
  for = "/assets/*"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "public, max-age=604800"

notes: Monetag's promise SDK (show_XXX) is documented for Telegram Mini Apps. If it
does not load on your domain the game runs ad-free and the rewarded button
hides itself; any page-level Monetag tag still earns independently.
Never ship this build to a game portal - their contracts forbid outside ad code.

platforms.label: Standalone (itch.io / self-hosted / Discord / Telegram)
platforms.revshare: You keep everything; itch.io's cut is whatever you set (10% default)
platforms.submission: zip, index.html at root, 'This file will be played in the browser'
head: <!-- No portal SDK. This build is the one to hand to itch.io, a Discord
Activity, a Telegram Mini App, a games-site licensee, or your own domain. -->
notes: No ads and no network calls beyond the P2P lobby - safe to embed anywhere.
Also the right base for a paid or licensed build.
